messages:
marie: Hey folks — trying to run the minimal Ruby sampleapp for a demo and the DB setup is failing on my mac. followed the README steps (brew postgres, bundle install, cp .env.example .env, rails db:setup) but `rails db:setup` errors with a connection refused. stack:

marie: ```
PG::ConnectionBad: could not connect to server: Connection refused
Is the server running locally and accepting connections on Unix domain socket "/tmp/.s.PGSQL.5432"?
``` 

marie: I can `psql` into the default DB fine, so not sure why the app can't. anyone seen this with the sampleapp? :confused:

ash: Did you set DATABASE_URL in .env or rely on config/database.yml? the sample app defaults to socket on mac which can be flaky with homebrew pg sometimes.

marie: I left it as default. what's the quick fix? edit database.yml to host: 127.0.0.1?

sam: try adding `host: localhost` under the dev config or set DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:pass@127.0.0.1:5432/app_dev

sam: also check permissions on /tmp — weird but I've hit socket path perms causing connection refused.

marie: ok doing that now...

lucy: another option: the Docker dev compose uses TCP host; for quick repro I run `brew services start postgresql` then export DATABASE_URL. keeps the sampleapp behavior consistent across machines.

marie: adding host: 127.0.0.1 fixed the connection, thanks! two quick follow-ups:
marie: 1) should README mention this edge case for mac/homebrew? 2) CI uses docker so no problem there, but new contributors might hit this.

ash: yes we should. small PR to README under "local postgres" note would help. mark it as community-friendly.

ben: if you open a tiny PR I can merge and backport to the quickstart branch. include the exact snippet (host: 127.0.0.1) and a one-liner `DATABASE_URL` example.

marie: will do in a bit. also noticed the sampleapp env example uses PG user `postgres` which doesn't exist by default on mac — gonna add a troubleshooting bullet.

ci-bot: note: created issue #1424 titled "sampleapp: clarify mac/homebrew Postgres local setup" for follow-up.

sam: thanks for filing, marie. small PRs are perfect. :+1:

marie: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/pull/289 — simple README addition + troubleshooting note

lucy: looks good, left a tiny nit about wording. once ben merges can we also add a short test in dev doc checklist to catch this in contributor guide? low priority.

ben: merged — thanks everyone. will cherry-pick to quickstart branch tomorrow.

marie: awesome, thanks all! saved my demo. :rocket:
